common.subject: Subject
landing.title: School planner
landing.lead: An agenda, grades from 1 to 6 and notes by subject for school life in Switzerland.
landing.feature1Title: Grades, weights and averages by subject
landing.feature1Text: Grades from 1 to 6 with their weights. Averages and progress update themselves.
landing.feature3Text: A shared place for activities and notes. Only what you need goes into your agenda.
landing.privacyText: Grades, absences and personal notes stay yours. Classmates only see the shared space.
landing.faq1Q: Does it replace the school's official system?
landing.faq1A: No. iPagell is a personal tool and does not replace official school communications.
landing.faq2Q: Can the class see my grades?
landing.faq2A: No. Grades, absences and personal notes stay private. The class only sees what is shared in its space.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use it on my phone?
landing.faq3A: Yes. iPagell works in the browser; in compatible browsers you can also add it to your Home screen.
landing.faq4A: You can view the planner already saved on this device. Pending changes try to sync when you reconnect; class activities need a connection.
landing.footer: Independent project. Does not replace your school’s official system.

install.safariStepsLabel: Add iPagell to the Home Screen with Safari
install.safariStepOne: In Safari, tap Share (or Page Menu → Share).
install.safariStepTwo: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.safariStepThree: Turn on Open as Web App if available, then tap Add.
install.chromeSteps: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen or Install app, if shown.
install.samsungSteps: In Samsung Internet, use the install icon in the toolbar or the Add to Home menu.
install.edgeSteps: In Edge, open the … menu and choose Add to phone, if available. This may create a Home Screen shortcut.
install.firefoxSteps: In Firefox, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen. A shortcut will be created.
install.headline: Add iPagell to your Home Screen

landing.metaDescription: iPagell brings together an agenda, grades from 1 to 6 and subject notes. The planner needs an account; online notes and the grade calculator also work without one.
landing.feature4Text: Headings, lists and bold text, organised by subject.
landing.step1Text: Username and password. Keep your recovery code safe.
landing.step2Text: Start with basic subjects or add your own.
landing.step3Text: See your average or next deadline straight away.
landing.faq5Q: Can I try it without an account?
landing.faq5A: Yes: online notes and the grade calculator work without an account. The planner and classes require one.
landing.faq6Q: Does iPagell fit my school in Switzerland?
landing.faq6A: Yes, if you use grades from 1 to 6 (6 is the highest). You set your subjects, weights and periods. Other scales aren’t supported; rounding and promotion follow your school’s rules.
